New issue 87 by bea...@alum.mit.edu: Matrix assign in transformed
parameter block does not respect size.
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=87

What version of Stan are you using? (type: "./bin/stanc --version" from the
command-line)

stanc version 1.1.0


What steps will reproduce the problem? (please attach a simple model and
data if appropriate)
1. Compile matrix_assign.stan: make matrix_assign
2. Run: matrix_assign --data=matrix_assign.data.R --iter=10
3. Inspect samples.csv


What is the expected output? What do you see instead?

samples.csv has more data columns than the header. Matrix assign in the
transformed parameter block is allowing a missized matrix to be assigned to
it.

The data block has two matrices, A and B. A is 1x2, B is 2x3.
Transformed parameters block has a 1x1 matrix, C. C is assigned to A * B,
which should not be allowed.

matrix_assign.stan 163 bytes
matrix_assign.data.R 86 bytes
